The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 11.3 is just above the fine-tuned maximum of 10.8 but far from quantized (2.2-2.3) and system-prompted (3.3-3.9), so it points to fine-tuned. Base is ruled out because the values are non-zero. System-prompted is ruled out because its KL and TV are higher and its top-1 agreement is lower.
